boxes.title: Bobbili & Padmanabham: more
items: Bobbili: ==**24 January 1757**==; queen **Mallamma Devi**; women's mass self-immolation
Revenge: **Tandra Paparayudu** killed Vijayarama Raju; source: play **Bobbili Yuddham**
Context: Treaty of **Aurangabad (1753)** gave Circars to French; **Tummala (1757)**
Padmanabham: **10 July 1794** (⚠ other notes: 8 July); Company demand **Rs 3 lakh** + disband troops
Son **Narayana Babu** (hid at **Makkuva**) restored: Permanent Settlement **1802**, **Rs 6 lakh** peshkash

boxes.title: Uyyalawada: added detail
items: Father **Pedda Mallareddy**; grandfather **Nosam** Palegar Jayarama Reddy
Followers: farmers, ==**Yanadis**==, tribals; PYQ 2022: born in Kurnool = correct
Pursued by Kadapa Collector **J.H. Cockrane**; Captain Russell, **Lt. Moore**
**₹1,000** reward; trial by ==**Faujdari Adalat**==; death sentence **January 1847**
Film **Sye Raa Narasimha Reddy** (**2019**); now in **Nandyal** district
